united_earth_is_1: Baningi kakhulu abantu abafuna ukusindisa iplanethi yethu. Izinhlangano eziningi, izinhlangano, izinkampani nabantu abangabodwa. Kepha asazi komunye nomunye.
united_earth_is_3: Kufanele sixhumane ukuze sibonise ukuthi ukunyakaza kwethu kunamandla kangakanani. Uma sazi ukuthi sibangaki, singasiza abantu ukuthi bashintshe imizwa yabo ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu babe nesibindi nokuzethemba. Singanikeza abantu amandla okusungula izindlela zabo zokuvikela isimo sezulu. Sisonke kuphela lapho singashintsha umhlaba futhi sitakule isimo sezulu!
united_earth_is_4: Shintsha umhlaba ngokubhalisa kuwebhusayithi yethu! Singabaningi!
united_earth_is_5: Sikumema ngokufudumele ukuthi wabelane ngalolu lwazi nabangane, ophathina kanye nabantu obajwayele.
united_earth_is_7: Abafundi abangama-200 nothisha abangama-30 esikoleni sase-Austrian
about_us_2: Uma sikhombisa ukuthi sibangaki, singasiza abantu ukuthi bashintshe imizwa yabo ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu kusuka ekuphelelweni ithemba baye ekubeni nesibindi nokuzethemba. Singanikeza abantu amandla okusungula izindlela zabo zokuvikela isimo sezulu.
about_us_3: Kepha ngaphezu kwakho konke: Besingeke sizizwe sisodwa futhi singenamandla. Kungasihlanganisa. Kungasinika ithemba, amandla, isibindi nokuzethemba. Singahle sizizwe sixhumekile emhlabeni wonke - sisindisa iplanethi yethu futhi sisebenzela ikusasa elingcono.
about_us_4: Inhloso yethu ukunikeza abantu isibindi, ukuzethemba namandla okuziqalela izindlela zabo zokuvikela isimo sezulu.
about_us_5: Ukunakwa: Akunampi ngenxa yemibono eyahlukene - ukukholelwa, hhayi ukuphoqwa kufanele kube yisisekelo sokuvikela iplanethi yethu.
about_us_6: Abantu abayi-100, bonke bekhuluma izilimi ezahlukahlukene, bagwedla ndawonye esikebheni babheka empophomeni. Cishe wonke umuntu osesikebheni uyasazi isimo esiyingozi. Kepha cishe wonke umuntu ucabanga ukuthi nguye kuphela owaziyo ngakho. "Yini engingayenza?", Wonke umuntu uyacabanga. "Ukugwedla kolunye uhlangothi akusizi ngalutho!" Futhi wonke umuntu uzitika ngokuziphatha okujwayelekile kwesikhathi esedlule. Yini ebingenzeka uma kungazelelwe wonke umuntu azi ngomunye nomunye - azi ukuthi wonke umuntu ufuna ukubuyela emuva futhi bakwazi ukuxhumana omunye nomunye?
about_us_8: I-United-Earth2025 - iphrojekthi encane yokuhambela i-ecolabel yase-Austrian.
about_us_9: Iwebhusayithi namakhasi ezokuxhumana axhunyiwe enziwa ngabafundi abangama-200 nothisha esikoleni sase-Austrian.
about_us_10: Le phrojekthi yenziwa njengephrojekthi encane yokuhambela i-ecolabel yase-Austrian. Zonke izinto zewebhusayithi zenziwe njengephrojekthi yesikole.
about_us_11: Singalandela izinkolo ezahlukahlukene, sehlukene ngeminyaka nangemvelaphi, kepha sonke sifuna ukusindisa iplanethi yethu. Bonke ababambiqhaza bangamavolontiya.

ws_saving_earth_text: Isimo somhlaba wethu siwohloka ngendlela emangalisayo, isomiso esandayo, izikhukhula, izivunguvungu nezivunguvungu, ukuncibilika kwamashidi amakhulu eqhwa, ukukhuphuka kwamazinga olwandle, amahlathi avuthayo, ubuthi bemifula namachibi, izintaba zodoti emhlabeni kanye nasolwandle nezinkulungwane zezinhlobo zezilwane nezitshalo ezingapheli. Umhlaba wethu usufinyelele umkhawulo wamandla awo. Sifuna ukonga iplanethi yethu ngaphambi kokuba kudlule isikhathi.
ws_peace_text: Umgomo wethu ukuhlalisana ngokuthula kwabo bonke abantu nabantu emhlabeni wethu. Singezosizo nokuxhasana. Simele ukwamukelana kanye nokuphathwa ngenhlonipho. Siyaqonda izidingo zabanye abantu. Siyisisombululo sokuthula sezingxabano. Sesikhulula ukuhlupheka nobuhlungu. Futhi singokuxhumana okuthula phakathi kwabo bonke abantu.
ws_forests_text: Sisebenzela ukuvikela amahlathi ethu nokuvikela ulwandle. Sizokuvikela imifula yethu namachibi ethu. Senzelwe ukugcina umoya wethu uhlanzekile futhi nokugcina phansi kuhlanzekile. Futhi siyakubona ukuxhumana phakathi kwazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezingabantu, izilwane nezitshalo. Uma amahlathi ethu nolwandle efa, sizokufa nathi. Akukho okukhona ngokuzimela.
ws_science_text: Sisebenzela isayensi nokucwaninga okusebenzela abantu neplanethi yethu. Kwezobuchwepheshe, kwizesayensi yemvelo, kwisayensi yezenhlalo nakwezomthetho, kwezolimo nakwezamahlathi, kwezokwelapha, nakwezokucwaninga nesayensi iyonke. Kungokuzinikela nokubambisana kwawo wonke umuntu kuphela lapho singavikela khona ukungashintshi, ukufudumeza ngokushesha okungaphezulu kuka-2 ° C.
ws_greenhouse_text: Asikho isabelomali se-CO2 esisele okufanele thina bantu sizikhiphe singene emkhathini. Kodwa-ke, ukukhipha igesi emhlabeni wonke okushisa emhlabeni kuyanda futhi ukugcwala kwamagesi abamba ukushisa emkhathini kuyanda kakhulu. Amagesi alandelayo abamba ukushisa abhekene nokushisa komhlaba. I-Carbon dioxide CO2, methane CH4 - factor 30, nitrous oxide N2O - factor 300, HFC - ifinyelela izikhathi ezingama-300,000)
ws_co2_text: Ukuqunjelwa kwamagesi abamba ukushisa emkhathini sekuvele kuphezulu kakhulu kangangokuba izinga lokushisa eliyi-1.5 ° C nangaphezulu lizokwenzeka. Kodwa-ke, ukuvela komphumela we-domino (amaphuzu wokuphonsa) kufanele kuvinjelwe. Ngakho-ke kufanele sikhiphe amagesi abamba ukushisa okuningi emkhathini ngangokunokwenzeka. Ngokutshala izihlahla, ukudala izikhala eziluhlaza nokunye okuningi.
ws_animals_text: Phakathi kwezinkulungwane eziyinkulungwane nezingu-10 000 ziyafa unyaka ngamunye. Ama-75% ezinambuzane ezinamaphiko ashonile eminyakeni engama-25 edlule. Ngaphezu kokufudumala, i-acidization olwandle yi-CO2 encibilikisiwe ingenye yezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kuholela ekuweni okukhulu kwenhlekelele kwayo yonke impilo yasolwandle. Uma amahlathi ethu, izilwane, izitshalo nolwandle kufa, khona-ke alikho ikusasa lethu thina bantu.
ws_preparing_text: Ukwanda kwezinga lokushisa lomhlaba jikelele okwamanje kuzungeze u-1.4 ° C futhi kuzokwenyuka kuye ku-1.5 ° C ngo-2029. Uma zonke izifundazwe, kuye kuwo wonke amazwe, zijwayeza ukuvikela isimo sezulu okunamandla, singanciphisa izinga lokushisa libe ngu-2 ° C. Izinhlekelele zemvelo, ukusweleka kokudla namanzi nokuqothulwa kwezinhlobo zezilwane kuzokhula kakhulu. Bonke abantu babhekene nezinselelo ngezinga elingakaze libonwe.
ws_awareness_text: Ngeshwa, bambalwa kakhulu abantu abaziyo ukuthi umubi kangakanani umhlaba wethu. Ngabe sonke asifuni ikusasa elihle nabazali bethu, izingane zethu, abazukulu bethu, izihlobo nabangane? Akufanele yini sihleke nabo, sibabambe futhi sizwe injabulo? Kumelwe nje siguqukele endaweni enhle. Masihlanganyele lo mlayezo nabanye abantu ngesibindi, ukuzethemba nothando.
